code.text: COAG
PANEL.MICRO

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pO₂, low pH), normocytic anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated acute phase reactants (ferritin, LDH). There is mild hypoalbuminemia and hypoproteinemia. Coagulation is altered (high INR, low PT). No evidence of current SARS-CoV-2 infection. Findings suggest severe respiratory compromise with systemic inflammation and possible bone marrow suppression; urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
